title: Women's 1500m World Rankings: November 2026
desc: The leading ten athletes in World Athletics' women's 1500m (Mile–2000m–Road Mile) event ranking as of 10 November 2026. Values are ranking points, not race times; associated mile, 2000m, road-mile and short-track performances can contribute. This dated top-ten snapshot is partial and the live source may change. Equal points are displayed as ties, while the official source assigns sequential places.
